title: Men’s transfer window summer 2026: all deals from Europe’s top five leagues
text:
All the latest Premier League, La Liga, Bundesliga, Ligue 1 and Serie A deals and a club-by-club guide

Women’s transfer window interactive guide

Second-tier side agree four-year contract with Paris-born midfielder who won bronze for Morocco at 2024 Olympics

Newly promoted side sign veteran centre-forward, 32, on two-year contract with option to extend by an additional year

Versatile 31-year-old wide man, who can also play at left-back, rejoins club where he spent 2021-22 season and first half of 2022-23

Well-travelled 33-year-old keeper joins relegated side in Serie B on two-year deal after three seasons at Stadio Luigi Ferraris

Having made his senior debut for Blues last season, England Under-19 winger heads to Portugal to polish his game

After struggling to break into first team in Bilbao, 26-year-old makes journey south to sign five-year deal with Andalusian club

Fabio Grosso's side break club transfer record to sign player rated among Serie A's most talented young midfielders

Morocco Under-23 winger wants 'to test myself at League One level' after previous spell in fourth tier with Bristol Rovers

Robins sign former Chelsea youth keeper to add depth after he was released by Sky Blues following promotion

Dominican Republic winger and former Real Madrid youth player departs for Poland after two seasons at club

Luxembourg centre-back who has played in seven different European leagues joins Serie B side with conditional obligation to buy

Well-travelled winger plans to 'bring energy, determination and leadership' to Sky Blues after signing five-year deal

Austrian side sign 32-year-old striker who scored 13 Bundesliga goals on loan at Borussia Mönchengladbach last term

Left-back's performances in Ligue 2 and then for Ghana at World Cup persuade Bundesliga side to make move

Talented 19-year-old moves to fellow CFG side who have earned promotion to Belgian top flight under Lee Johnson
